batch: C03d.1 prescribed smooth behavioral physical-event providers

environment.timeout_scope: Harness timeout, not a measured performance acceptance bound.

source_hash_scope: Committed compiled source for the optimized worker run. Native development/final runs have their separate source scopes below. Hashes cover local working-tree bytes of the committed files.

implementation.admission: Structurally smooth prescribed time expressions, with supported analytic time instructions and no circuit references or integral state. Includes polynomial, sinusoidal and selected smooth unary expressions; constants must also have supported compiled instructions. Domains requiring a regularity proof, switched expressions and dynamic/circuit-dependent providers remain unavailable.
implementation.equations: Behavioral voltage sources supply physical voltage constraints and slopes with solved finite/impulse current ownership. Behavioral current sources contribute physical KCL and explicit time partials; admitted finite memoryless current has zero impulse. Reuses the existing bounded analytic expression evaluator and canonical charge-event solver.
implementation.state: Evaluation uses a fresh context and private expression workspace; accepted behavioral VM state is not mutated. Startup stationarity requires structural constancy, not a sampled zero slope. Smooth forcing participates in continuous-side certificates; future switched/stateful admission requires its own event causes and state owners.
implementation.resources: Derivative workspace deducts the coexisting prepared model/topology/equation estimate from the configured value budget and preserves typed resource/cancellation failures. Whole-run allocation and memory qualification remains open.
implementation.physical_family_census: 11 of 38 families admitted, with instance predicates; 27 other families and remaining admitted-instance restrictions still require disposition/implementation.

coverage.unit_contracts: Structural regularity/stationarity, source rates and physical KCL, cancellation inside analytic evaluation, typed derivative resource limit, and zero-initial-slope startup provenance.
coverage.gp_positive_matrix: 42 public execution calls: three dialects, both polarities, with/without prescribed behavioral current; 12 full OP runs, 12 checkpoint runs, 12 resumes and six UIC runs. Independent GP collector/instantaneous base-charge laws at every published sample, including the outgoing arrival clock.

gp_oracle_limits.arrival_clock_s: 8 * f64::EPSILON * 1e-9, only for identifying the authored arrival; current gates remain unchanged

coverage.line_matrix: Nine public execution calls: full run, checkpoint and resume in all three dialects. Matched 50-ohm line driven by a prescribed sine source; independent half-amplitude delayed-wave oracle, first wavefront timing, complete impulse inventory and no forced acceptance. Absolute waveform gate 5e-5 V includes the bounded 2 ps linear-history interpolation error. A resumed segment beginning at 1.2 ns is not expected to re-publish the 1 ns wavefront.
coverage.negative_matrix: Four public exact-delay cases retain explicit diagnostics for switched, cornered, circuit-dependent and integral behavioral expressions. These checks do not count as delivered providers.
coverage.behavioral_unit_scope: 122 selected behavioral-related tests pass, with zero failures/ignores; these overlap the broader transient selection and must not be summed as distinct cases.
coverage.native_integration_scope: 79 selected tests across eight targets, with zero failures/ignores.
coverage.wasm_scope: 24 selected tests across four targets, zero failures/ignores on committed optimized core source in a Chrome dedicated worker. The new matched-line target is native-only in this batch. Enabling veriloga-wasm-jit is not external-model/JIT qualification.

resolved_development_failures: Initial gp-behavioral-public-probe.log failed compilation because the new test treated the resume (result, checkpoint) tuple as a result; corrected before its successful public runs.
The new native cancellation fixture used Cell rather than a thread-safe counter required by AbortSignal; corrected to AtomicUsize.

The new matched-line test checked for the 1 ns arrival in a resumed segment starting after that event. The assertion now applies only to segments containing that clock; waveform, impulse completeness and no-forced-acceptance gates remain active in both full and resumed results.
remaining: All C00-C14 packages remain open. This implements the original smooth prescribed behavioral reproducer and a bounded provider subset, not C03d.1 or the entire C03 package.
Circuit-dependent, switched, stateful and other unsupported expression domains, plus VCVS/VCCS/CCCS/CCVS physical event equations and their independent oracles remain C03d.1 work.
C03d.2-.5 retain the other native/stateful/external family and instance predicates. Physical-event support is distinct from periodic support.
C03c still requires separate Weil feedback/private-node oracles, further parameter/cutoff/depletion/overlap/temperature/scaling and rejection/restart cases.
Whole-run allocation/memory, inner-solve cancellation latency, remaining configurations and measured performance limits remain open.
No new live ngspice/Xyce run, full-crate test run or application/platform certification is claimed.
